frontmatter.title: MTech in Artificial Intelligence — Course Catalog by Cluster

chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text:
Overview
Courses for the MTech in Artificial Intelligence are organized into five subject clusters: Core, Application, Mathematical Analysis, Research Work, and Guided Course. Credit values written as "2+1" mean 2 lecture credits plus 1 lab or practical credit, for a total of 3 credits; other courses list a single flat credit value. This catalog lists available subjects only — it does not specify which courses are mandatory, how many credits must be taken from each cluster, or the total credits required to graduate, so that information should be confirmed separately with the department before being used to answer degree-completion questions.
